subject: general
question: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height. B is taller than E but shorter than F. Only one person is shorter than C. Only three people are taller than A. E is not the shortest. Who is the tallest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height.

1) B is taller than E but shorter than F.

F > B > E

2) E is not the shortest.

3) Only one person is shorter than C.

F > B > E > C > _

3) Only three people are taller than A.

F > B > E > A > C > _

Then final arrangement:

F > B > E > A > C > D

So,** F** is the tallest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"F".**
